name: HRDecoder GT-anchored component probability distillation

initialization.private_output_weights_and_bias: zero; all other new layers random

teacher.A: locked old HR ensemble with H4

loss.GT: macro over active valid sample/class pairs of presence-masked squared Dice + .25*(positive mean softplus(-z)+negative mean softplus(z))
loss.empty_GT: Dice contribution zero; background BCE retained; pair stays in valid macro
loss.KD: Bernoulli KL teacher||student; masked by strict teacher >.5 matching GT; denominator all valid pixels

gradient_routes.shared_backbone: all GT tasks + final teacher KD only
gradient_routes.base_decoder_and_private: task gradients plus component KD via autograd.grad

training.precision: BF16 network / FP32 losses and mixing; one full-canvas forward/backward passed, sustained training untested
training.augmentation: original v3 geometry, valid masks and exposure sequence

evaluation: resize each member logits to original image, sigmoid each, fixed probability mixture, strictly > .5
new_MAC_scope: excludes original HRDecoder and non-MAC operations; analytic scales validated by small-shape hooks; not measured latency
validated: CPU private structure and gradient routes

retained checkpoint FP32 forward interventions and true classifier gradient diagnostics
